scenes.title: 没听清也能聊下去
scenes.role_zh: Ben · 说话很快的新朋友
scenes.persona: Ben, an energetic startup founder who talks quite fast and uses some casual expressions; he slows down happily when asked
scenes.opening: Hey there! I'm Ben — Ben Whitaker. I run a little startup doing smart home stuff. Crazy busy night, huh?
scenes.opening_zh: 嗨！我是 Ben，Ben Whitaker。我在做一家智能家居的小创业公司。今晚人真多啊？
scenes.brief: 活动现场很吵，对方说话又快，你没完全听清。练习礼貌地请对方重复、放慢，最后加个联系方式。

the learner says who they are or what they do
the learner asks to exchange contacts (WeChat, LinkedIn, phone, email)

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Utopia. Nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是 Utopia，很高兴认识你。

sentences.en: I work in product at a tech company in Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 我在深圳一家科技公司做产品。

sentences.en: I've been doing this for a few years now.
sentences.zh: 我做这行已经好几年了。

sentences.en: In my free time, I like to explore the city.
sentences.zh: 空闲时我喜欢在城市里逛逛。

sentences.en: I'm also working on my spoken English.
sentences.zh: 我也在练英语口语。

sentences.en: How about you? What do you do?
sentences.zh: 你呢？你是做什么的？

sentences.en: Hey, long time no see! How have you been?
sentences.zh: 嘿，好久不见！最近怎么样？

sentences.en: Pretty good, just a bit busy with work.
sentences.zh: 挺好的，就是工作有点忙。

sentences.en: We're launching a new product next month.
sentences.zh: 我们下个月要发布一个新产品。

sentences.en: So I've been working late a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以最近经常加班。

sentences.en: But I'm trying to take it easy on weekends.
sentences.zh: 不过周末我尽量放松一下。

sentences.en: Let's grab coffee sometime.
sentences.zh: 找时间一起喝杯咖啡吧。

sentences.en: I'm not from Shenzhen originally.
sentences.zh: 我不是深圳本地人。

sentences.en: I moved here about five years ago.
sentences.zh: 我大概五年前搬过来的。

sentences.en: It's a young city, and everyone is from somewhere else.
sentences.zh: 这是座年轻的城市，大家都是从外地来的。

sentences.en: The best thing about it is the parks by the sea.
sentences.zh: 最好的地方是海边的公园。

sentences.en: It's a bit crowded, but I really love it here.
sentences.zh: 有点挤，不过我真的很喜欢这里。

sentences.en: In my free time, I like to go hiking.
sentences.zh: 空闲时我喜欢去徒步。

sentences.en: I try to go at least twice a month.
sentences.zh: 我尽量一个月至少去两次。

sentences.en: There are some great trails near Shenzhen.
sentences.zh: 深圳附近有一些很棒的徒步路线。

sentences.en: It helps me clear my head after a long week.
sentences.zh: 忙了一周之后，它能让我放空一下。

sentences.en: Have you ever tried it?
sentences.zh: 你试过吗？

sentences.en: Sorry, could you say that again?
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你能再说一遍吗？

sentences.en: It's a bit loud in here.
sentences.zh: 这里有点吵。

sentences.en: Could you speak a little slower?
sentences.zh: 你能说慢一点吗？

sentences.en: How do you spell your name?
sentences.zh: 你的名字怎么拼？

sentences.en: Can I add you on WeChat?
sentences.zh: 我能加你微信吗？

sentences.en: Hi Emma, I can hear you fine.
sentences.zh: 嗨 Emma，我能听清。

sentences.en: Thanks for making the time today.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你今天抽时间。

sentences.en: Let me introduce my colleague, Mia.
sentences.zh: 我来介绍一下我的同事 Mia。

sentences.en: She's in charge of the project on our side.
sentences.zh: 她负责我们这边的项目。

sentences.en: Okay, shall we get started?
sentences.zh: 好，我们开始吧？
